thread.title: Stock Market Today: Stocks Stage Big Rally Off Early Lows, But Turn Negative Again

author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Stock Market Today: Stocks Stage Big Rally Off Early Lows, But Turn Negative Again
text:
The major market averages mustered a strong rebound after opening sharply lower Tuesday, but then erased gains in volatile action. The tech-heavy Nasdaq fell 0.1% in the stock market today . The S&P 500 and   average fell 0.2% and 0.1%, respectively.
X Meanwhile, the VIX — a key measure of market volatility — briefly spiked above 50, its highest level since August 2015, before falling back under 30.
A mong the  s , Apple ( AAPL ) rose 1% but it's finding resistance at its 200-day line after falling below that key level on Monday. Shares have already triggered the 7%-8% loss-cutting rule from a 176.34 flat-base buy point. 
On the downside, Merck ( MRK ) fell for a third straight day, moving down 2%. Shares are nearing their 52-week low after analyst firm Leerink Swann cut the stock's price target from 69 to 67.
Top retailer Lululemon ( LULU ) rose 0.6% amid news that CEO Laurent Potdevin abruptly resigned from the company . Shares are attempting to find support at their 50-day line and are extended from a 64.91 buy point. At its peak on Jan. 8, shares had risen as much as 26% from the buy point.
Among companies reporting earnings , automakers General Motors ( GM ) and Toyota Motor ( TM ) were solidly higher after announcing better-than-expected earnings . GM rose 4% after its Q4 number came in above estimates. The stock is trying to regain some its losses after a string of declines sent the stock down through its 50-day line.
Meanwhile, Toyota is trying to stem its recent losses, as it finds support near its 50-day line, rising 4%. The stock broke out past a flat base's 128.21 entry and had a nice gain until the general market's recent slide.
